supersedes.reason: The v2 sliced arm exposed an asynchronous lifecycle defect: speculative groups crossed policy updates, exceeded the call budget, and left a singleton ReDCO group during terminal drain. V3 changes only lifecycle enforcement and evidence validation; the scientific arms, order, seeds, exposure, thresholds, and confidence procedure are unchanged.

prior_failed_run.status: terminal integration failure with no learning comparison
prior_failed_run.exclusion: All v2 sliced-arm outcomes are excluded from v3 estimation and decision-making. They were used only to diagnose the lifecycle failure. No v2 reward, gradient, or adapter result changed v3 seeds, order, sample counts, thresholds, confidence, or model settings.

purpose: Test whether exact-snapshot branch credit improves learning over trajectory broadcast on identifiable finite probes, while requiring full-suffix and sliced replay to agree in-loop.

scope.run_order_derivation: Unchanged from v2: Python random.Random(7202605).shuffle over the lexically declared arm list before any live observation.
scope.training_probe_suite: the unchanged eight standard probes; the v8 integration-only needle is excluded

strict_snapshot_lifecycle_contract.incomplete_redco_group: hard integration failure before advantage computation

rollout_and_filter_contract.reason: Zero-advantage samples retain explicit zero weights and contribute zero gradient. Keeping rather than dropping them preserves the frozen 1200-call budget and prevents stochastic empty-batch retries from changing arm exposure.

integration: all three v3 arms complete their frozen step counts with exactly the frozen serialized trace and policy-call totals
every training and evaluation trace contains exactly one policy call
every training and evaluation trace uses policy version step minus one
both ReDCO arms contain exactly 960 branch records
every ReDCO target is committed before action sampling
every ReDCO branch reports exact sliced/full reward equivalence
each arm has at least one positive finite gradient step
each arm saves its final LoRA adapter
no arm writes gathered full-model weights
learning: both branch-credit arms meet the unchanged preregistered improvement point threshold over broadcast
both paired 90 percent lower confidence bounds exceed zero
sliced and full-suffix meet the unchanged preregistered equivalence margins
decision_rule.pass: the frozen CPU estimator prerequisite, v8 live integration smoke, all v3 integration checks, learning checks, and replay-mode equivalence check all pass
decision_rule.failure: report Gate GC v3 as failed without changing thresholds or retrying an observed v3 arm

resource_policy.alternative_policy: A different non-spot 2x48GB non-A100/non-H100 resource at no more than 2.00 USD/hour requires a committed hardware-only amendment before provisioning.

scope_limitations.budget_match: 1200 total policy calls per arm; branch evaluations are reported and are not equal because broadcast has no counterfactual branches
scope_limitations.reason: The restricted deterministic verifier deliberately executes both reward paths in-loop, so full and sliced modes have identical model-call topology and do not measure accelerator savings.
scope_limitations.headline_if_passed: minimal synthetic learning and estimator result only, not evidence on real RLM tasks
